findings.reason: the design's own delivery already reduces `forward_operator.py` to helpers or removes it, so the new-module-versus-extend choice is a naming detail rather than a behavioural gap.
findings.text: §4 introduces `gs.apply` as a module whose body is the composition `ForwardFluxOperator` already performs ("Map a trial poloidal flux to the flux its plasma current generates", `nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:2323`), and the plan does not state why that map cannot be extended in place

findings.reason: an unnamed owner at retirement is exactly the fork the design's own delivery forbids, and naming one file per function is a one-line plan change that removes the ambiguity before §6 lands.
findings.text: §6 says "`fixed_point.py`, `forward.py` and `forward_operator.py` shrink to the four functions and their receipts", while the landed design places `current.book`, `gs.apply` and `solve.fixed_point` in new modules `current.py`, `gs.py`, `solve.py` (design §Four signatures: "`topology.py` is replaced in place; `current.py`, `gs.py` and `solve.py` absorb their respective responsibilities"); the two readings disagree on which file owns each function

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `topology.read` hides a contour tree, branch selection and sub-cell fragmentation behind one signature, and `current.book` hides fragmentation plus exact-clip quadrature behind one signature; the design explicitly forbids a second public booking or solver, so the complexity sits behind the interface rather than spread across wrappers. The existing `Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity` methods (`nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1396`,`:1376`) already return domain labels and the axis/separatrix state, and the design replaces `topology.py` in place — an extension of the owner.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan names no single file owner for the map and solve functions, so it stays open whether new modules fork the existing `forward_operator.py` and `fixed_point.py`.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §1's landed design (`docs/research/converged-forward-solve-design.html`) carries a revision-bound inventory of 17 null-role and 23 region-role source files, each with a real source marker and an absorb/delete destination, and §4 names the implicit Picard, moment-map and boundary-flux envelope derivative contracts it carries over, so the plan cites the existing mechanism it extends rather than adding a subsystem blind.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §4's `gs.apply(ψ) = ψ_ext + G @ book(ψ, read(ψ))` is a four-line composition over a map the codebase already has.
